summary: Iter-75: Verified new /api/accounts/export endpoint for normal (non-admin) users. All 10 new tests + 5 iter-74 regression tests pass. Endpoint returns HTTP 200 for normal users with proper CSV body/headers, includes all 27 expected columns when include_credentials=true, hides passwords when false, decrypts SMTP+IMAP passwords correctly, mirrors SMTP into IMAP when imap_password_encrypted is missing but imap_host is set, strictly isolates data between normal users and super admin, round-trips through /api/accounts/smtp/bulk-import header normalizer, and returns 401 for unauthenticated requests.

minor.issue: Login is gated by Turnstile in the preview environment — returns 400 'Security verification failed' for scripted logins. Tests that need real super-admin sessions had to insert user_sessions rows directly in Mongo. Not a bug in the new export endpoint, just a test-env constraint.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 8933 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline and should be split into modules (email_accounts, campaigns, drips, backup, etc.). Not blocking, but a growing risk.
The new export endpoint correctly excludes MongoDB _id, uses async db calls, decrypts via decrypt_data helper, and gates on get_current_user with strict user_id filter — implementation looks solid.
Consider adding rate-limiting on /api/accounts/export since it returns plaintext credentials on demand.
test_credentials: Super admin dhruvmathur208@gmail.com available; login endpoint blocked by Turnstile in preview so tests seed sessions directly.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 tagged normal users (user_a, user_b) + 1 super-admin session, each tagged with TAG='exp75_<uuid>'. All tag-prefixed docs cleaned up at module teardown across users, user_sessions, email_accounts, campaigns, drip_campaigns, tracked_domains collections.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter-75 export endpoint is fully verified. Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_iter75_normal_user_accounts_export.py; run with pytest. Note: login endpoint is Turnstile-gated in preview — use direct Mongo user_sessions inserts to obtain a session_token for any user (see _mk_user helper).
rca of the issue: Original bug (404 on Export CSV for normal users) was caused by frontend calling /api/infrastructure/accounts/export which requires can_access_infrastructure permission. Fix added new /api/accounts/export endpoint gated on get_current_user (any authenticated user) with strict {user_id: user.user_id} Mongo filter. CSV shape mirrors the Infrastructure export so it re-imports cleanly via /api/accounts/smtp/bulk-import. Verified independently: no cross-user leaks, iter-72 isolation preserved for super admin, IMAP-password fallback works, unauthenticated calls return 401.
